pages.title: Olive & Grain - Farm-to-Table Restaurant
pages.html:
🌾 Olive & Grain
Menu Reservations

Olive & Grain

Farm-to-Table Dining in the Heart of Portland

Experience seasonal, locally-sourced cuisine crafted with care. From our garden to your table, every dish tells a story of connection to the land.

Reserve Your Table

This Week's Highlights

Grilled Heirloom Tomato Salad

Charred tomatoes, burrata, basil oil, and crispy bread crumbs. A celebration of summer's best.

$14

Pan-Seared Halibut

Wild-caught halibut with roasted root vegetables, brown butter, and fresh dill from our garden.

$32

Braised Short Rib

Tender beef short rib braised in local red wine, served with creamed polenta and seasonal greens.

$36

Full Menu

Appetizers

Roasted Beet & Goat Cheese

$12

Roasted golden and red beets, local chèvre, candied walnuts, micro greens, beet vinaigrette.

Smoked Trout Rillettes

$13

House-smoked trout, crème fraîche, capers, toasted rye bread, lemon.

Crispy Chickpea Fritters

$11

Spiced chickpea fritters, tahini yogurt, pickled vegetables, cilantro.

Seasonal Mushroom Soup

$10

Foraged mushrooms, thyme, garlic, cream, crusty bread.

Mains

Herb-Brined Chicken Breast

$28

Free-range chicken brined with herbs, served with crispy potatoes, spring vegetables, pan jus.

Grass-Fed Ribeye Steak

$42

12 oz locally-raised ribeye, grilled to perfection, served with charred broccolini and béarnaise sauce.

Vegetable Grain Bowl

$22

Farro, quinoa, roasted seasonal vegetables, tahini dressing, crispy chickpeas, pomegranate.

Line-Caught Salmon

$34

Pacific salmon, lemon butter, haricots verts, roasted fingerling potatoes.

Handmade Pappardelle

$26

Wide ribbon pasta with wild boar ragù, pecorino romano, fresh parsley.

Desserts

Dark Chocolate Torte

$9

Rich flourless chocolate cake, raspberry coulis, whipped cream, fresh berries.

Seasonal Fruit Tart

$8

Butter pastry, crème diplomate, fresh local fruits, apricot glaze.

Lavender Panna Cotta

$8

Silky lavender panna cotta, candied lemon, shortbread cookie.

Make a Reservation

Join us for an unforgettable meal. Reserve your table below, or call us at (503) 555-0147.

Olive & Grain

Address: 247 Market Street, Portland, OR 97214

Phone: (503) 555-0147

Hours: Tue–Thu 5–10pm, Fri–Sat 5–11pm, Sun 5–9pm

Closed Mondays

© 2024 Olive & Grain Restaurant. All rights reserved.
